+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+root = Path(sys.argv[1])
+out = Path(sys.argv[2])
+workset = json.loads((root / ".ai/task/repair-w61-20261001/WORKSET.json").read_text())["items"]
+expected_ids = {item["entry_revision_identity"] for item in workset}
+expected_args = {
+    "ab25e27abc3a48040031a37c6c408cab352b5cf017ce3160e83da63f591248c7": [1,2,3,4,10,9,5,6,7,8],
+    "abf96746331a5e91a289d365842bd81875a818938770bd6048f6c515ca1ef7b8": [1,2,3,4,8,9,5,6,7],
+    "49f7781bff7a125f3f99d733ef59e99ed9696796f78cb3bfdcac513f345addb5": [1,2,3,4,7,6,5],
+    "7cba41f15fc74d1bf49edf9e1d0bf625a99944eb2459ba2bf1d18fcb8de2212e": [1,2,3,4,6,7,5],
+}
+
+def load(path):
+    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines()]
+
+def semantic(record):
+    return {k: v for k, v in record.items() if k != "line"}
+
+items_by_file = {}
+for item in workset:
+    items_by_file.setdefault(item["normalized_path"], []).append(item)
+
+changed = []
+args_changed = []
+before_after = []
+for name in ("mod-tome.lua", "tome-ashes-urhrok.lua", "tome-cults.lua"):
+    before = load(out / (name + ".baseline.jsonl"))
+    after = load(out / (name + ".current.jsonl"))
+    assert len(before) == len(after), (name, len(before), len(after))
+    index_to_item = {}
+    for item in items_by_file[name]:
+        matches = [i for i, rec in enumerate(before)
+                   if rec.get("kind") == "translation"
+                   and rec.get("source") == item["source"]
+                   and rec.get("source_tag") == item["source_tag"]
+                   and rec.get("target") == item["target_preimage"]
+                   and rec.get("args_order") == item["args_order"]]
+        assert len(matches) == 1, (item["entry_revision_identity"], matches)
+        index_to_item[matches[0]] = item
+    for i, (old, new) in enumerate(zip(before, after)):
+        old_sem, new_sem = semantic(old), semantic(new)
+        if i not in index_to_item:
+            assert old_sem == new_sem, (name, i, old_sem, new_sem)
+            continue
+        item = index_to_item[i]
+        rid = item["entry_revision_identity"]
+        assert old_sem["target"] != new_sem["target"], rid
+        changed.append(rid)
+        allowed = {"target", "args_order"}
+        assert {k for k in old_sem if old_sem[k] != new_sem[k]} <= allowed, rid
+        if old_sem.get("args_order") != new_sem.get("args_order"):
+            args_changed.append(rid)
+            assert new_sem["args_order"] == expected_args[rid], (rid, new_sem["args_order"])
+        assert new_sem.get("args_order") == expected_args.get(rid), rid
+        old_target, new_target = old_sem["target"], new_sem["target"]
+        if rid == "074d7c0b7e919740e833eabc6cef88869e1ebe11c926ad40da9b3ac4ea45548e":
+            assert new_target.count("\n") == old_sem["source"].count("\n")
+            assert new_target.count("\n") == old_target.count("\n") + 1
+            assert new_target.count("\t") == old_sem["source"].count("\t")
+        else:
+            assert new_target.count("\n") == old_target.count("\n"), rid
+            assert new_target.count("\t") == old_target.count("\t"), rid
+        before_after.append({"id": rid, "file": name, "before": old_target, "after": new_target,
+                             "args_order_before": old_sem.get("args_order"),
+                             "args_order_after": new_sem.get("args_order")})
+
+assert set(changed) == expected_ids
+assert len(changed) == len(expected_ids) == 22
+assert set(args_changed) == set(expected_args)
+report = {
+    "status": "PASS",
+    "loaded_files": 3,
+    "changed_target_count": len(changed),
+    "changed_target_ids": sorted(changed),
+    "changed_args_order_count": len(args_changed),
+    "changed_args_order_ids": sorted(args_changed),
+    "other_semantic_records_unchanged": True,
+    "lf_tab_invariants": True,
+    "before_after": sorted(before_after, key=lambda row: row["id"]),
+}
+print(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
*** Add File: /tmp/repair_w61_render.lua
